title: Reverse Integer
summary: Reverse the decimal digits of a signed 32-bit integer, preserving its sign.
statement: Reverse the decimal digits of a signed 32-bit integer, preserving its sign. Return 0 if the result would be outside the signed 32-bit range. Solve without storing a 64-bit integer.

examples.explanation: The middle zero stays between the reversed digits.
Preserve the sign and drop the leading zero after reversal.
The reversed magnitude exceeds the signed range.

hints: Conceptual: Trailing zeros disappear after reversal.
Directional: Extract signed digits without taking the absolute value of the signed minimum.
Implementation: Before appending each digit, check the result against the quotient and last-digit bounds for signed 32-bit limits.
complexityAnalysis: O(number of digits) time and O(1) extra space.
